components.name: Field Control
components.description: Accessible text input for forms and filters.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:#171717;font:700 14px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:48px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid #d7dee7;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#171717;font:400 15px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif}.ds-field input:focus{outline:3px solid rgba(18,61,104,.16);border-color:#123d68}

components.name: Status Chip

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: A shared surface for compact, comparable dashboard metrics.
components.css: .ds-metric-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 16px 42px rgba(17,43,68,.07);font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',Arial,sans-serif}.ds-metric-strip div{display:grid;gap:4px;padding:20px 24px}.ds-metric-strip div+div{border-left:1px solid #e7e9ee}.ds-metric-strip strong{color:#092b4c;font-size:28px}.ds-metric-strip span{color:#667085;font-size:13px}

narrative.overview: A warm local education brand paired with precise, dependable learning tools. Public pages use split editorial introductions; staff and student screens use quiet academic workspaces.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red identifies the primary action or most important state.

rules.name: The Modal Supremacy Rule
rules.body: No animated or elevated surface may compete with dialogs.

dos: Balance headings and use pretty body wrapping.
Use divided rows for comparable learning and operational items.
donts: Do not repeat generic icon-card patterns.
Do not use red as decoration on every heading.
